scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:prod: BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/web-client run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:prod && git add artifacts/api-server/dist artifacts/web-client/dist/public && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: release build') && git push
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
